svg.desc: System FMEA failure chains, sheet 3 of 7 (SFM rev 0.26): failure modes SFM-010 to SFM-014 (6 failure modes, 15 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-2 · System FMEA failure chains — sheet 3 of 7
SFM rev 0.26 · BL-005 · draft · SFM-010 … SFM-014 · 15 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
Insufficient deceleration for lead vehicle or stop
End effect: Rear-end collision if the driver does not brake
Lead missed due to radar/vision fusion fault
Safety model minimum accel limit prevents required braking (by
Brake system does not achieve requested deceleration
Loss of longitudinal control without driver alert
End effect: Driver unaware; closing on lead
Powertrain ignores requests without fault signal
TX path to vehicle lost silently
Late reaction to lead vehicle braking
End effect: Rear-end collision or harsh late braking
Pipeline latency (CPU overload, thermal throttle, messaging delay)
Longitudinal command frozen at last value
End effect: Unintended acceleration when the frozen request is
controlsd hangs while card keeps sending the last carControl
plannerd stops or runs late while engaged, so controlsd keeps using
Messaging delivers a stale longitudinal plan or command with fresh
on driver request with entry conditions met;
Engagement without driver request or with entry
End effect: Unexpected steering/acceleration; driver surprised
Cruise state or button parsed incorrectly (spurious enable)
Fails to disengage when a fault requires it
End effect: Any F1/F2 hazardous effect continues
Event missing for the fault (no detection)
Event mapped to wrong reaction type in events.py
Catch-all commIssue suppressed by the no_system_errors logic

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
